tasks.name: Site establishment / temp fencing
tasks.basis: General outdoor set-up, usually partly workable.

tasks.name: Erosion & sediment controls
tasks.basis: Often still required in wet weather, but slower and messier.

tasks.name: Bulk earthworks
tasks.basis: Highly exposed to wet ground and access deterioration.

tasks.name: Detailed earthworks / trim subgrade
tasks.basis: Fine tolerances make wet conditions painful.

tasks.name: Cut to fill / cartage
tasks.basis: Wet haul roads and loaded traffic slow the whole chain.

tasks.name: Building platform / pad prep
tasks.basis: Moisture condition and compaction control matter.

tasks.name: Drainage trenching
tasks.basis: Water ingress, slumping, and access issues.

tasks.name: Manholes / chambers
tasks.basis: Less affected than open trench runs, but still exposed.

tasks.name: Service trenches / ducting
tasks.basis: Small but still sensitive to rain and reinstatement.

tasks.name: Bored piles / drilled holes
tasks.basis: Wet ground and hole stability are key risks.

tasks.name: Driven poles / posts
tasks.basis: Weather affects access and standing time.

tasks.name: Retaining wall excavation
tasks.basis: Slope and spoil handling usually worsen in the wet.

tasks.name: Retaining wall installation
tasks.basis: Less exposed than excavation, but still affected.

tasks.name: External concrete placing
tasks.basis: Rain cover, surface quality, and finishing risk.

tasks.name: External concrete finishing
tasks.basis: Finishing window can vanish fast in poor weather.

tasks.name: Kerb & channel
tasks.basis: Open-air concrete work and wet prep surfaces.

tasks.name: Subbase / pavement prep
tasks.basis: Compaction and moisture sensitivity.

tasks.name: Asphalt / sealing
tasks.basis: Very weather-sensitive process.

tasks.name: Landscaping / topsoil / grassing
tasks.basis: Often still possible, but efficiency drops.

tasks.name: Roof framing
tasks.basis: Rain and wind both matter before dry-in.

tasks.name: Roofing
tasks.basis: Wind-sensitive and usually fully exposed.

tasks.name: Wall framing (open structure)
tasks.basis: Some work can continue, but pace drops.

tasks.name: Cladding
tasks.basis: Exposure remains but some sequencing is possible.

tasks.name: Exterior windows / joinery
tasks.basis: Protection set-up often needed.

tasks.name: Deck framing
tasks.basis: Exposed external carpentry.

tasks.name: Decking
tasks.basis: Still weather-sensitive, but slightly less than framing.

tasks.name: Scaffolding
tasks.basis: Wind can be the bigger issue here.

tasks.name: Steel erection / crane lifts
tasks.basis: High wind sensitivity plus exposure.

tasks.name: External block / brick laying
tasks.basis: Rain protection and mortar issues.

tasks.name: External painting / coatings
tasks.basis: Often weather-window driven.

tasks.name: Internal framing
tasks.basis: Still gets minor drag from access, shelter, and material handling.

tasks.name: Internal linings / plasterboard
tasks.basis: Low weather effect, not zero.

tasks.name: Internal plastering / stopping
tasks.basis: Mostly protected, but drying and access can still bite.

tasks.name: Internal painting
tasks.basis: Humidity and site conditions can slow productivity.

tasks.name: Fitout / cabinetry / joinery
tasks.basis: Low but real weather drag.

tasks.name: Internal tiling / wet areas
tasks.basis: Protected, but humidity and site wetness can still influence output.

tasks.name: Internal flooring
tasks.basis: Low but non-zero effect.

tasks.name: Internal MEP rough-in / fit-off
tasks.basis: Protected, but deliveries and wet access still matter.

tasks.name: Workshop fabrication / sheltered prep
tasks.basis: Low but not zero.

sources.limitation: Official climate normal. A wet day is not automatically a construction lost day.
